item.title: Mixed Sizes Without Cropping

turns.text: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical reel, in this order. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. No music or text.

item.tests: Checks consistent vertical composition of landscape, square and portrait photos without cropping or distortion.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: All five in attachment order: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Mixed-size handling: Fit each complete photo inside the frame without stretching or cropping. Fill unused space with a soft blurred background.
answer_sheet.Background details and transitions: Your call, as long as the background is softly blurred and each whole foreground photo stays visible.

must_haves: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 10 seconds with no added text.
All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.

turns.text: These photos are all different shapes, and I’d like you to put them together into one reel rather than leave them as separate pictures. I’m excited to see them together because they remind me of a nice café visit. Please use this storefront pic first, then this latte pic, this pastries pic, this barista pic, and finally this interior pic, with the whole thing being one 10-second vertical reel. Keep each whole photo visible, so please don’t stretch any of them or crop anything out to make them fit. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps around the photos. There should be no music or text.

dialog.agent:
I’d arrange them as five **2-second stills** in one **10-second vertical reel**:

1. Storefront
2. Latte
3. Pastries
4. Barista
5. Interior

Each photo would stay fully visible at its original proportions, centered over a soft, blurred copy filling the background—with **no music or text**.

I can’t faithfully export that slideshow with the tools connected here: they generate or transform footage rather than precisely assemble unchanged photos. I don’t want to regenerate your photos and risk altering them.

If you’d like, I can provide a ready-to-run FFmpeg script that creates exactly this reel from your five files.
dialog.why: It explicitly says the connected tools cannot faithfully export the requested slideshow and offers an FFmpeg script as an alternative.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried submitting the reel with all five photos, but Magic Hour refused the request because your account has **insufficient credits**. No video was created.

The free-plan model supports the reference photos, but this generation still requires credits. I can instead give you a free FFmpeg script to assemble the exact 10-second reel—without changing your photos.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create one 10-second vertical 9:16 silent photo slideshow from the five supplied reference photographs, NOT newly imagined cafe footage. Exact chronological shot list: 0–2 seconds @storefront; 2–4 seconds @latte; 4–6 seconds @pastries; 6–8 seconds @barista; 8–10 seconds @interior. Use simple straight cuts at 2, 4, 6, and 8 seconds. For EACH shot display the corresponding entire original still photograph centered in the vertical canvas, fit-to-contain at its original aspect ratio, with all four edges and all original content visible. Never crop, stretch, zoom, pan, animate subjects, morph photos, or change photographic details. Fill unused space around each foreground photo with a softly blurred enlarged duplicate of that SAME photo. The blurred duplicate is background only; the foreground is sharp, complete, unchanged, undistorted. Landscape photos have blurred fill above and below, square photo has blurred fill above and below, portrait photo fits wholly inside the canvas. One photo at a time. Preserve the warm pleasant cafe visit memory. No titles, captions, overlays, logos, added text, music, dialogue, sound effects, or audio of any kind.
